rules.rule_name: Post-Cancellation Charges, Unexpected Downgrade & Refund Inquiries
rules.description: Customer claims they were billed after cancelling, unexpectedly dropped from Premium to Free, or requests a refund.
rules.mandatory_instruction: Acknowledge payment concern empathetically, inform customer that financial details must remain private, request Direct Message with account email address and receipt date, and escalate to billing tier 2.
prohibited_actions: Never promise an instant refund in a public response
Never ask for credit card numbers, CVV, or passwords in tweets or DMs
Never dispute user claim publicly without private account lookup

rules.description: Customer observes two identical charges in the same billing cycle.
rules.mandatory_instruction: Clarify that duplicate pending charges often reflect temporary authorization holds that expire within 48-72h. If two charges cleared, request DM with account email to inspect duplicate active accounts.
prohibited_actions: Never ask user to post bank statements publicly

rules.rule_name: Subscription Tier Changes & Student / Family Plans
rules.description: Customer inquires about plan pricing, student SheerID verification, or Family plan address verification.
rules.mandatory_instruction: Explain plan prerequisites: all Family plan members must reside at the same physical address; Student plans require SheerID re-verification every 12 months (up to 4 years). Direct to spotify.com/account.
prohibited_actions: Do not bypass SheerID verification requirements

rules.description: Customer pays for Spotify through Apple iTunes App Store, Google Play, or mobile telecommunications carrier.
rules.mandatory_instruction: Clarify that Spotify cannot directly cancel or refund subscriptions managed by third-party platforms. Instruct customer to manage subscriptions directly via device settings (Apple Subscriptions or Google Play Subscriptions).
prohibited_actions: Do not attempt direct Spotify cancellation for Apple-managed billing
